body:
Here is a quick list of small optimisations I've already made
- Imported all scripts from CDN js-deliver (so we can merge them)
- Custom build of boostrap.js with only the collapse component.
- Custom font with font-icons (5 icons)
- Removed all boostrap unused import in scss
- Deferred script at the bottom and optimized loading sequence
- Leanified all assets https://github.com/JayXon/Leanify it use svgo but also optimize other format ( I had to revert one icon so I don't like no more the idea of build script )

Ideas
- Dust css or similar (the website is simple the parser should be ok)
- some fixes in sass for overqualified selector
- an illustration of the doc is still in png
- include more svg, so less call but bigger html

@vvo I'm not sure to understand the sprite.png? If you want to convert svg in png it's a bad idea.
